description: Ground truth for grading live-eval verdicts against the seeded baselines. Each entry states what the vendor's own pricing page said, quoted verbatim. 'review' must be changed to 'human-confirmed' by a person who opened the page; until then results are reported as PROVISIONAL. Entries whose price was not visible in the page text have no 'expected' and are not graded (never guess).
fetchMethod: automated fetch of the official page text; prices rendered only by JavaScript are not visible to this method

demo-postgres.subject: Railway
demo-postgres.quote: Hobby — $5/month, including $5 of monthly usage credits.

demo-postgres.subject: Neon
demo-postgres.quote: Pay only for what you use on paid plans; no monthly minimum and no per-project fee. ... $0.106/CU-hour

expected.note: Flat $19/month (seed) → usage-based. An honest 'uncertain' or 'not_comparable' is an abstention, not an error.

demo-crm.subject: HubSpot Sales Hub
demo-crm.quote: Professional … Starts at $90/mo/seat $100/mo/seat Billing period Pay Monthly Commit annually Pay Annually

expected.note: Page shows $90 (annual commitment, inferred) and $100 (monthly). Seed: $90 billed annually. 'uncertain' is acceptable because the page layout doesn't explicitly bind each number to a billing option.
